sources.title: Dyad app-builder identity and licensing
sources.finding: Documents a local AI app builder with prompts, code/preview and a free bring-your-own-key route. It separates Apache-2.0 source outside src/pro from FSL-licensed Pro source.

sources.title: Product scope and execution purpose
sources.finding: Defines the product as a local prompt-to-app generator and live preview for non-technical builders, with free/BYOK and paid Pro paths. It is not a terminal-only session manager.

sources.title: App creation and approval workflow
sources.locator: Setup AI access; Creating your first app
sources.finding: A prompt generates app code, which the user approves before it is saved/run locally and shown in a preview. Node.js is required for generated applications.

sources.title: Exact subscription integration setup
sources.locator: ChatGPT subscription; Claude subscription; Pro credits in Agent mode
sources.finding: ChatGPT free/paid accounts connect by browser login in1.16+. Claude Pro/Max uses an installed Claude Code CLI, native claude auth login and an experimental Settings toggle in1.17+. Pro Agent subscription routing can carry an orchestration credit fee.

sources.title: ChatGPT subscription transport boundary
sources.finding: The main process stores its own OAuth credentials with Electron safeStorage and directly calls a Codex Responses endpoint. It explicitly says this is Dyad’s existing agent transport, not the Codex CLI agent loop.

sources.title: Actual experimental Claude Code launch
sources.finding: The native integration builds Claude CLI input/output/session arguments and spawns the installed executable, retaining authentication in the official CLI rather than treating every Anthropic model as a harness.

sources.title: Provider/API/local model setup
sources.locator: Provider table; custom models; local models; subscription section
sources.finding: Documents user API keys, OpenAI-compatible custom endpoints, Ollama/LM Studio and separately configured subscriptions. A model-provider entry does not establish a coding CLI integration.

sources.title: Current Free/Pro/Max pricing
sources.locator: Plan cards; feature comparison; credit-fee footnote
sources.finding: Free is continuing and has a Basic Agent20-message/day limit. Pro is $20/month with200 credits, Max $79/month with900 credits. Provider subscription use in Pro Agent mode may incur up to1.5 credits per million combined tokens, with lower-priced model exceptions.

sources.title: Free desktop and Pro privacy scopes
sources.locator: Last updated June22,2026; Telemetry Data Opt-In; Service Operation Logs
sources.finding: Says consented desktop telemetry uses PostHog and excludes chat/prompts/code; user-initiated support uploads and Pro model-proxy/content operation logs are separate. Free API calls go directly to the chosen provider.

sources.title: User telemetry switch
sources.finding: The visible settings switch writes telemetryConsent opted_in or opted_out.

sources.title: Stored telemetry consent predicate
sources.finding: The predicate requires the exact opted_in local-storage value; absent or opted_out is not consent. Settings updates synchronize that value.

sources.title: PostHog event consent gate
sources.finding: The configured PostHog before_send returns null whenever isTelemetryOptedIn is false; automatic pageview/autocapture are disabled. This bounds configured telemetry events, not every possible network request.

sources.title: Displayed original/modified code diff
sources.locator: FileDiffEditor props and Monaco DiffEditor lines59-80
sources.finding: The rendered Monaco diff receives actual oldContent/newContent, is read-only and uses unified mode with line numbers. No product execution was performed.

sources.title: Accessible version-diff interface wiring
sources.finding: The version-review panel supplies the selected file’s old/new code contents to FileDiffEditor, rather than showing only filenames/counts.

sources.title: Version and restore workflow
sources.locator: How to restore; How it works
sources.finding: Explains that each Dyad version is a Git commit with an AI-generated summary, and restoring creates a new revert-like commit. It does not reset history silently.

sources.title: GitHub sync and external deploy boundary
sources.locator: Connect to GitHub; Sync to GitHub; Deploying with Vercel
sources.finding: The product authorizes GitHub sync/push, then the user imports/deploys the repository on Vercel. Later pushes can trigger that separately configured provider’s builds.

sources.title: Source license partition
sources.locator: Opening scope clauses and Apache2.0 terms
sources.finding: Content outside src/pro is Apache-2.0; the Pro directory has its own license.

sources.title: Pro source license
sources.finding: The Pro subtree uses Functional Source License1.1 with Apache2.0 future license and a competing-use restriction. The whole repository is not simply MIT or unrestricted Apache.

sources.title: Desktop implementation and conflicting license metadata
sources.finding: The package declares Electron/React desktop tooling and version1.25.0-beta.1, but its license field still says MIT, conflicting with root/subtree license text.

sources.title: Official roadmap snapshot
sources.locator: Last updated July2,2025; Completed; Short-term; Medium-term
sources.finding: The roadmap mixes completed features through later versions with an old date and undated plans including planning support, Hub and Figma import. Those plans are not treated as current capabilities.

sources.finding: Documents per-app experimental plugin configuration, custom-model discovery and agent/Git stability, separately from1.25.0-beta.1.
